arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, a Non-Boss enemy who you Poisoned for more than their remaining Life is killed instantly and unleashes {c_important}Scourge{/c}. {c_important}Scourge{/c} increases your Poison damage by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
